column2: What in the world did $$バアル$$ mean by what he said earlier?!
For now, we have no choice but to go to the next city.
The rulers of each city are bound to know something!!
Yeah!
What a waste of all that food!!
And they say even the town diner is that delicious!
What on earth do they use for ingredients?!
Hey!
You ate at that diner earlier, right?!
No... Never mind... Then that's good!
You were right not to eat there!
The ingredients in that food were...
his leftovers after he devoured people!!
What happened to everyone else in the city?!
You defeated Lord $$バアル$$, so they got scared and ran away or shut themselves inside!!
Though that isn't too different from normal!
The people here had become completely dependent on $$バアル$$...
My $$御主人$$ ran away too!
So, I have a favor to ask...
Could I come with you too?!
Take her with us!!
Don't take her along!
Yay! Thank you! I'm $$パリティ$$—nice to meet you!
My specialties are cooking and seeing through people's habits!
I'll definitely be useful!!
$$パリティ$$ joined the party!
I knew it!
Someone like me would only be a burden if I came along!
It's fine... I'll keep running the diner here!
If you're ever nearby, come eat here again!!
“The chains break.”
